definitions.page_or_line_pointer: provenance.page_hint is set OR affected_lines is set
definitions.verified_source_ref: file_sha256 present AND pinned source_location exists under repo root AND sha256(pinned bytes)==file_sha256 AND clone_head pin present (matches validate_v31 no-invention)

span_byte_availability.note: V3 sources are METADATA_ONLY (NOTICE.md). A resolvable char_span over a PDF indexes an extractor output (source_span.text_basis in despaced_copy|source_text), not the raw pinned-file bytes; the referenced bytes cannot be hash-reproduced from the PDF, so the span is marked unavailable rather than guessed.
